rules.title: Ubiquitous language
rules.text: Use each bounded context's own terms (harness.toml contexts.*.terms) in names, tests and intent. A term from another context inside this one is a translation the code must make explicit.

rules.title: Declare a cross-context change
rules.text: A change touching more than one bounded context names them in its intent ('Contexts: billing, catalog') so the boundary crossing is a decision, not an accident.

rules.title: Hold the context's invariants
rules.text: Each touched context's invariants (harness.toml contexts.*.invariants) are listed in the slice; a test asserts every invariant the change can break.
